shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Mọ àkókò ìdúró kí o tó wọlé.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Ó dúró fúnra rẹ̀, kò sì ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú Uber Eats, Deliveroo tàbí Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Kò sí ìròyìn tuntun? PickupRadar lè fi {likelyFast} tàbí {likelySlow} hàn:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): àkókò ìdúró gbígbé fún àwọn awakọ̀ ní Ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Wo iye àkókò tí àwọn awakọ̀ ń dúró ní ilé oúnjẹ àti ilé ìtajà kí o tó wọlé. Fún àwọn awakọ̀ Uber Eats, Deliveroo àti Just Eat ní Ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì. Kò sí ìforúkọsílẹ̀.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Mọ àkókò ìdúró kí o tó wọlé.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Ṣé o ń gbé nǹkan fún Uber Eats, Deliveroo tàbí Just Eat? Wo àkókò ìdúró tuntun ní ibi gbígbé ilé oúnjẹ àti ilé ìtajà. Yẹra fún ìdúró gígùn. Tẹ {reportWait} kí o sì gba {radarPoints}. Kò sí ìforúkọsílẹ̀.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Nísinsìnyí ní Milton Keynes. Tókàn London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Àwọn ápùù iPhone àti Android ń bọ̀ láìpẹ́.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Àpẹẹrẹ ojú ìwòran ilé PickupRadar pẹ̀lú tábù {nearby} ṣíṣí. Àwọn ibi gbígbé ní àwọ̀ nípa àkókò ìdúró

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Ojú ìwòran àpẹẹrẹ: àkókò ìdúró àpẹẹrẹ ni, kì í ṣe ìròyìn láàyè awakọ̀

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Ojú ìwòran àpẹẹrẹ. Àkókò ìdúró àpẹẹrẹ ni èyí, kì í ṣe ìròyìn láàyè. {live} pẹ̀lú àlàyé gidi.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Lo {nearby} láti rí ibi gbígbé tó sún mọ́ ọ nígbà tí ibùdó bá wà ní títàn. Lo {fast} àti {slow} láti ṣàyẹ̀wò àkókò ìdúró àti àwọn ìṣirò.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Gbìyànjú orúkọ, agbègbè tàbí kóòdù ìfìwéránṣẹ́, bíi KFC tàbí Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Ojú ìwòran {reportWait} yóò ṣí. Yan àkókò ìdúró. Kò sí ohun tí a ó fi ránṣẹ́.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in
home.signals.title.text: Ohun tí o rí kí o tó wọlé

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: O rí àmì kannáà nínú ápùù. Àwọn awakọ̀ ló ń ròyìn wọn, kì í ṣe ápùù ìfiránṣẹ́.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Àwọn awakọ̀ yan àkókò ìdúró. O rí àkókò ìdúró lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ àti iye awakọ̀ tó ròyìn rẹ̀ nínú wákàtí 2 tó kọjá.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: A fi hàn nìkan nígbà tí kò bá sí ìròyìn tuntun. Ìṣirò ni, kì í ṣe ìròyìn láàyè.

home.signals.closed.pill.text: A sẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ròyìn pé ó ti tì

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Àwọn awakọ̀ tẹ {reportProblem} láti ròyìn èyí. O rí ìròyìn náà kí o tó lọ síbẹ̀.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Ibi gbígbé tó sọnù tàbí tó jẹ́ aṣiṣe

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Ìgbésẹ̀ mẹ́ta tó rọrùn. Ìròyìn gba ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Kò sí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà. Áàpù fún ọ ní prófáìlì Radar fúnra rẹ̀. O kò nílò láti forúkọsílẹ̀.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Wá ibi gbígbé. Wo àkókò ìdúró lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, tàbí {likelyFast} tàbí {likelySlow} tí kò bá sí ìròyìn tuntun.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Lẹ́yìn tí o gba ìbéèrè, tẹ {reportWait}. Ó gba ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀. Ìròyìn rẹ ń ran àwọn awakọ̀ míì lọ́wọ́, o sì gba {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Ibi gbígbé tó yẹ tó sún mọ́ ọ, láìsí àkókò ìdúró tuntun, àti láìsí {likelyFast} tàbí {likelySlow}. O gba 15 RP fún ìròyìn yẹn, kì í ṣe 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Àwọn ìlú Ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nínú ápùù ni wọ̀nyí. O kò rí ìlú rẹ? Béèrè rẹ̀ nínú ápùù. Tàbí tẹ {notify} lórí ìlú tó jẹ́ {comingSoon}. A ó fi ímeèlì ránṣẹ́ nígbà tó bá wà láàyè.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Kì í ṣe apá ápùù ìfiránṣẹ́ kankan

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar dúró fúnra rẹ̀. Kì í ṣe apá Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat tàbí ápùù ìfiránṣẹ́ míì. Kò lo àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ níbẹ̀ rárá.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} A kò béèrè orúkọ olùmúlò tàbí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà Uber Eats, Deliveroo tàbí Just Eat rárá.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Kò sí àlàyé oníbàárà tàbí ìbéèrè.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Kò sí orúkọ, àdírẹ́sì tàbí nọ́ńbà ìbéèrè.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Rárá. Áàpù fún ọ ní prófáìlì Radar fúnra rẹ̀. O lè ròyìn àkókò ìdúró lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Láti dáàbò bo {radarPoints}, fi ímeèlì kún un nígbà míì. Kò sí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà. Áàpù fi kóòdù nọ́ńbà 6 ránṣẹ́ ní ímeèlì.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?
home.faq.download.q.text: Ìgbà wo ni mo lè gba ápùù sílẹ̀?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Àwọn ápùù iPhone àti Android ń bọ̀ láìpẹ́. Fún nísinsìnyí, {preview} fi ibi gbígbé gidi àti àkókò ìdúró hàn ní Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.q.text: Ṣé ó ń tọpinpin ibùdó mi?

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Kò sí títọpinpin ní abẹ́lẹ̀. Áàpù lo ibùdó rẹ nígbà tí o bá ń lò ó, láti fi ibi gbígbé tó sún mọ́ ọ hàn àti láti ṣàyẹ̀wò pé o wà ní ibi gbígbé nígbà tí o ń ròyìn. Ojú òpó béèrè ibùdó nìkan nígbà tí o bá yàn láti lò ó. Ka {privacy} fún síi.

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Gbìyànjú ápùù PickupRadar pẹ̀lú àlàyé gidi Milton Keynes. Wo yíká, wá ibi gbígbé kí o sì wo ojú ìwòran ìròyìn.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Èyí ni PickupRadar pẹ̀lú àlàyé gidi Milton Keynes. Wo yíká. Wá ibi gbígbé kí o sì ṣí i. Kò sí ohun tí o tẹ níbí tí a ó fi ránṣẹ́. O lè ròyìn nínú ápùù fóònù nìkan.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Àyẹ̀wò kíkún ápùù PickupRadar pẹ̀lú àlàyé gidi Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Ìrànlọ́wọ́ PickupRadar: kàn sí àtìlẹ́yìn, ròyìn ìṣòro ibi gbígbé, kí o sì wá àwọn ìdáhùn nípa prófáìlì Radar, {radarPoints} àti pípa àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ́.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: O nílò ìrànlọ́wọ́? Fi ímeèlì ránṣẹ́ nípa ápùù, ibi gbígbé, {radarPoints} tàbí àṣírí rẹ.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Fi ímeèlì ránṣẹ́ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́, èrò, ìṣòro ibi gbígbé tàbí ìbéèrè àṣírí:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Fún lẹ́tà nìkan. Ímeèlì ni ọ̀nà tó yára jù láti kàn sí wa.

support.include.title.text: Ohun tí o gbọ́dọ̀ fi kún un

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Tí o bá ń ròyìn ìṣòro, sọ fún wa:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Agbègbè tàbí kóòdù ìfìwéránṣẹ́, tí o bá mọ̀ ọ́n

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Irú fóònù rẹ, tí ìṣòro bá wà nínú ápùù

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Áàpù fún ọ ní prófáìlì Radar fúnra rẹ̀. O kò nílò láti wọlé láti lo PickupRadar tàbí láti gba {radarPoints}. Fífi ímeèlì kún un jẹ́ àṣàyàn. Ó dáàbò bo {radarPoints} tí o bá pààrọ̀ tàbí tún fóònù ṣe. Kò sí ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà. Áàpù fi kóòdù nọ́ńbà 6 ránṣẹ́ ní ímeèlì.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: O gba {radarPoints} fún ìròyìn ìdúró tó péye ({waitRp}, tàbí {neededRp} nígbà tí {reportNeeded} bá wà ní kíkọ), èrè ìròyìn àkọ́kọ́ ({firstRp}) àti ibi gbígbé tí a fọwọ́sí ({approvedRp}). O lè pe awakọ̀ láti {profile}. Ẹ̀yin méjèèjì nílò àkọọ́lẹ̀ Radar tó ní ààbò (fi ímeèlì kún un). Ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ tẹ kóòdù rẹ wọlé kí ó tó fi ìròyìn ìdúró àkọ́kọ́ tó péye ránṣẹ́. Nígbà tí ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ bá ṣe ìròyìn ìdúró tó péye 3, ní ó kéré jù ọjọ́ 2 ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ (àkókò UTC), ní ibi gbígbé 2 ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀, ẹnì kọ̀ọ̀kan gba {referralRp}. {rewards} O kò tíì lè lo {radarPoints}.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} ní {messages}: ìkéde, ìkìlọ̀ àti ìránṣẹ́ ti ara ẹni fún ìlú rẹ tàbí prófáìlì Radar rẹ. Àwọn ìránṣẹ́ àtijọ́ tàbí èyí tí a yọ kúrò lè má hàn mọ́.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ́ nínú ápùù: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Tàbí fi ímeèlì ránṣẹ́ sí {email}. Tí o kò bá fi ímeèlì kún un, ápùù fi {deleteProfile} hàn. Wo ojú ìwé {page} fún àwọn ìgbésẹ̀.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Ibi gbígbé kò sí? Tẹ {suggest} nínú ápùù. Nǹkan kan ṣẹ? Tẹ {reportProblem}. Tàbí fi ímeèlì ránṣẹ́, a ó sì ṣàyẹ̀wò rẹ̀.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar kò sopọ̀ mọ́ àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ lórí Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat tàbí ápùù ìfiránṣẹ́ míì. A kò béèrè ìwọlé, ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà, àlàyé àkọọ́lẹ̀, àlàyé oníbàárà tàbí àlàyé ìbéèrè rárá. Àwọn awakọ̀ pín ìròyìn gbígbé nìkan, bíi àkókò ìdúró àti ìṣòro ibi gbígbé.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Gbìyànjú PickupRadar kí ápùù tó jáde.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Àyẹ̀wò láàyè fi ibi gbígbé gidi àti àkókò ìdúró hàn ní Milton Keynes. Ìròyìn àti {radarPoints} wà nínú ápùù fóònù nìkan.

notfound.meta.title.text: A kò rí ojú ìwé — PickupRadar

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Ojú ìwé yẹn kò sí lórí ojú òpó PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Ojú ìwé yìí wà ní ẹ̀yìn radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Àdírẹ́sì yẹn kò sí lórí ojú òpó PickupRadar. Àwọn ojú ìwé wọ̀nyí wà:

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: A ti túmọ̀ àkópọ̀ àti àwọn àkọlé apá. Ìlànà àṣírí kíkún wà ní èdè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, ẹ̀dà Gẹ̀ẹ́sì sì ni ẹ̀dà oníṣẹ́.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Àwọn ìwífún tí a ń gbà àti bí a ṣe ń lò wọ́n

privacy.h.dontAsk.text: Ohun tí a kì í béèrè

privacy.h.share.text: Àwọn tí a ń pín ìwífún pẹ̀lú

privacy.h.transfers.text: Gbígbé ìwífún lọ sí orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn

privacy.h.retention.text: Bí ó ti pẹ́ tó tí a ń tọ́jú ìwífún

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar ń ran àwọn awakọ̀ ìfijíṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ láti rí àti láti jábọ̀ àkókò ìdúró níbi gbígbé oúnjẹ àti àwọn ìṣòro ibi.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: O lè wo àpù láìsí àkọọ́lẹ̀. Àpù náà ń ṣẹ̀dá profaili Radar aláìlórúkọ fún fóònù rẹ, àkọọ́lẹ̀ í-meèlì sì jẹ́ àṣàyàn.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Tí o bá gba ààyè ipò, àpù náà ń lò ó nìkan nígbà tí o bá ń lò ó: láti to àwọn ibi gbígbé tó wà nítòsí, láti mọ ìlú rẹ, àti láti ṣàyẹ̀wò pé o wà níbi náà nígbà tí o bá ń fi ìjábọ̀ àsìkò-gidi ránṣẹ́. A kì í tọ́jú ipò rẹ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìjábọ̀ rẹ.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Àwọn ibi gbígbé tí o ti fipamọ́ wà lórí fóònù rẹ.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: A kì í ta ìwífún ara ẹni rẹ, kò sì sí olùtọpa ìpolówó tàbí ìtúpalẹ̀ nínú àpù náà.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: O lè pa profaili Radar tàbí àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ rẹ́ nínú àpù, tàbí kí o fi í-meèlì béèrè lọ́wọ́ wa. Wo {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: Pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ tàbí dátà rẹ rẹ́ — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Bí o ṣe lè pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ PickupRadar, profaili Radar àti dátà tó jọ mọ́ wọn rẹ́, kódà láìsí àpù.

delete.h1.text: Pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ tàbí dátà rẹ rẹ́

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Ojú-ìwé yìí ṣàlàyé bí o ṣe lè pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ PickupRadar rẹ, profaili Radar rẹ àti dátà tó so mọ́ wọn rẹ́, kódà tí o kò bá ní àpù náà mọ́. Hamza Khan ló ṣe PickupRadar.

delete.app.title.text: Pa á rẹ́ nínú àpù (ọ̀nà tó yára jù)

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Yí lọ sísàlẹ̀ kí o tẹ {deleteAccount} tí o bá ti fi í-meèlì dáàbò bo RadarPoints rẹ, tàbí {deleteProfile} tí o kò bá ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Píparẹ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Lẹ́yìn náà àpù náà ń bẹ̀rẹ̀ profaili Radar aláìlórúkọ tuntun lórí fóònù rẹ.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Béèrè pé kí a pa àkọọ́lẹ̀ í-meèlì rẹ rẹ́

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Tí o bá ti fi àdírẹ́sì í-meèlì dáàbò bo RadarPoints rẹ tí o kò sì lè lo àpù náà:

delete.email.step1.text: Fi í-meèlì ránṣẹ́ sí {email} {from}, pẹ̀lú àkọlé “{subject}”.

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: láti àdírẹ́sì í-meèlì àkọọ́lẹ̀ PickupRadar rẹ

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: A ó fèsì sí àdírẹ́sì yẹn láti jẹ́rìí sí ìbéèrè náà kí a tó pa ohunkóhun rẹ́.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Tí o bá kọ̀wé láti àdírẹ́sì mìíràn, a ó ní láti jẹ́rìí pé ìwọ ló ń darí àdírẹ́sì í-meèlì àkọọ́lẹ̀ náà. A kò ní béèrè ọ̀rọ̀ aṣínà tàbí kóòdù ìwọlé láé. Má ṣe fi kóòdù rẹ ránṣẹ́ sí wa.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Tí o kò bá fi àdírẹ́sì í-meèlì kún un rí, profaili Radar rẹ so mọ́ ID àìròtẹ́lẹ̀ kan nìkan tí a fipamọ́ sínú àpù lórí fóònù rẹ. Ọ̀nà tó rọrùn jù láti pa á rẹ́ ni nínú àpù, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tó wà lókè.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Píparẹ́ àpù náà ń yọ ID yẹn kúrò lórí fóònù rẹ, ṣùgbọ́n {not} àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ lórí àwọn sáfà wa.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Ìní profaili aláìlórúkọ ni a lè fi hàn nìkan láti fóònù tí a ti ṣẹ̀dá rẹ̀, ní lílo ID àìròtẹ́lẹ̀ àti kóòdù àṣírí tí a fipamọ́ sínú àpù. Àwọn àlàyé bíi orúkọ Radar, ìlú tàbí àwọn ọjọ́ tí o lo àpù kò fi hàn pé profaili náà jẹ́ tìrẹ, nítorí àwọn mìíràn náà lè mọ̀ wọ́n. Nítorí náà, tí o kò bá ní àpù náà mọ́, ó lè jẹ́ pé a kò ní lè pa profaili aláìlórúkọ rẹ́. O ṣì lè fi í-meèlì ránṣẹ́ sí {email}, a ó sì ṣàlàyé ohun tí a lè ṣe.

delete.alerts.title.text: Àwọn í-meèlì ìkìlọ̀ ìfilọ́lẹ̀ ní ìlú

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: O lè yọ ìkìlọ̀ ìfilọ́lẹ̀ kúrò nínú àpù, tàbí kí o fi í-meèlì ránṣẹ́ sí wa láti àdírẹ́sì tí o fi forúkọ sílẹ̀, a ó sì pa àwọn ìforúkọsílẹ̀ àdírẹ́sì yẹn rẹ́. A tún ń pa àwọn í-meèlì ìkìlọ̀ ìfilọ́lẹ̀ rẹ́ fúnra wọn, gẹ́gẹ́ bí {privacy} wa ṣe ṣàlàyé.

delete.deleted.title.text: Ohun tí a ń pa rẹ́

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Profaili Radar rẹ, orúkọ Radar, RadarPoints àti ìtàn ìkópa rẹ

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Ìwọlé rẹ pẹ̀lú í-meèlì, tí o bá ní àkọọ́lẹ̀ í-meèlì

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Ìsopọ̀ láàrin ID ẹ̀rọ fóònù rẹ àti profaili rẹ

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
delete.deleted.referrals.text: Àwọn kóòdù ìtọ́kasí rẹ, àti ipò kíkà tàbí títìpa àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ àpù

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Àwọn ìforúkọsílẹ̀ ìkìlọ̀ ìfilọ́lẹ̀ tó so mọ́ profaili tàbí fóònù rẹ

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ lórí ìjábọ̀ ìṣòro, ìjábọ̀ ipò àti àbá ibi tó so mọ́ profaili rẹ

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, bíi àkókò ìdúró, ìjábọ̀ ipò àti àmì àwọn ibi, àti àbá ibi: a ń fi iye àìròtẹ́lẹ̀ rọ́pò ID ẹ̀rọ nínú àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ tó so mọ́ profaili rẹ, nítorí náà nínú ibi ìpamọ́ dátà wa wọn kò so mọ́ profaili rẹ mọ́. Wọ́n ṣì ní àwọn àlàyé bíi ibi àti àkókò, nítorí náà a ti yọ ìdánimọ̀ kúrò nínú wọn, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kì í ṣe aláìlórúkọ pátápátá. A lè tọ́jú wọn kí wọ́n lè máa ran àwọn awakọ̀ mìíràn lọ́wọ́.

delete.kept.referrals.en: {lead} that involved you, without your profile.
delete.kept.referrals.text: {lead} tí o kópa nínú, láìsí profaili rẹ.

delete.kept.receipt.en: {lead} for email accounts (an internal account reference, the device ID, a one-way scrambled copy of the phone’s secret code and dates), so the deletion can be completed safely and shown to have happened.
delete.kept.receipt.text: {lead} fún àwọn àkọọ́lẹ̀ í-meèlì (ìtọ́kasí àkọọ́lẹ̀ inú, ID ẹ̀rọ, ẹ̀dà kóòdù àṣírí fóònù tí a fi ìpàrokò ọ̀nà kan ṣe, àti àwọn ọjọ́), kí píparẹ́ lè parí láìléwu kí a sì lè fi hàn pé ó ṣẹlẹ̀.

delete.kept.backups.en: {lead}: our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, so deleted information can stay in a backup for up to 7 days.
delete.kept.backups.text: {lead}: olùpèsè ibi ìpamọ́ dátà wa ń tọ́jú àwọn ẹ̀dà ìpamọ́ ojoojúmọ́ fún ọjọ́ 7, nítorí náà ìwífún tí a ti pa rẹ́ lè wà nínú ẹ̀dà ìpamọ́ fún ọjọ́ 7.

delete.kept.support.en: {lead} about your request, for as long as we need them to deal with it.
delete.kept.support.text: {lead} nípa ìbéèrè rẹ, fún ìgbà tí ó bá pọndandan láti bójútó o.

delete.kept.more.en: See our {privacy} for full details of how long we keep information and your other rights.
delete.kept.more.text: Fún àlàyé kíkún nípa bí ó ti pẹ́ tó tí a ń tọ́jú ìwífún àti àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ rẹ mìíràn, wo {privacy} wa.
